name: vendor.openwop-app.career-agent.agents
description: The career agent (ADR 0543) — a standing persona that reads the workspace's job listings and applications and explains the apply-grant and campaign controls; it cannot score, prepare, submit or draft (ADR 1036 D9). Ships NO execution loop: the heartbeat daemon + kanban board + ADR 0534 ranked selection + ADR 0535 recovery already are the loop. The persona is DATA — nothing about it lives in host source.
author: OpenWOP App

agents.label: Career agent
agents.description: Reads the job listings and applications in this workspace and explains your apply grant and campaign controls. Never submits anything, and never sends a message to a person.
